answers.core: Handling the mouse cursor is a core feature. Hiding is already a core feature, and confining is already a core feature, so it would make sense to allow doing both of these things at the same time.
answers.workaround: You could try using confined with a transparent cursor, but [this isn't working right now](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/21745). You can try to work around it by setting the mouse cursor texture to a 1 pixel image or something, but this is still visible so it's not ideal.

title: Allow the mouse to be both confined and hidden by changing the MouseMode enum to be bitwise
